title.zh: 仍受支持的修复与维持关系再形成
title.en: Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation

claim.zh: 在既有支持门控规律中，起初仍受支持的贡献路径若在缺口步数内持续有正净贡献，便保持自身支持并恢复维持活动所需的条件。若两项活动都失去支持，实际水平此后不变，即使后续输入表仍列有贡献。两个实际取用历史从同一初值出发、后续输入相同，却分别恢复与不恢复；恢复历史既非全程更新型，也非永久消耗型。
claim.en: Within the existing support-gated law, an initially supported contribution route with positive net contribution throughout a deficit-length window keeps its own support and restores the sustaining activity. If both activities lack support, the reached level remains constant despite later nominal contributions. Two actual draw histories have the same initial level and later inputs but opposite recovery outcomes; the recovered history is neither all-time renewing nor permanently consuming.

hypotheses.zh: 一个自然数条件、两项按阈值获得支持的活动及既有更新递推。贡献与取用只在焦点活动受支持时实际进入变化，维持更新也只在维持活动受支持时发生。
hypotheses.en: One natural-number condition, two threshold-supported activities and the inherited recurrence. Contribution and drawing enter actual change only while the focal activity is supported; sustaining renewal is likewise support-gated.

hypotheses.zh: 有限恢复结论要求初始修复支持，以及随后 needG − level T 步每步 contrib > draw；这一供给安排及其来源不由定理导出。
hypotheses.en: Finite recovery requires initial repair support and contrib > draw at each of the next needG − level T steps; the schedule and its source are supplied.

hypotheses.zh: 不恢复结论限于两项活动均未获支持、无第三条注入、无阈值修订或条件替代的同一规律；脉冲见证具体给定初值、阈值与输入。
hypotheses.en: Non-recovery is restricted to the same law with both activities unsupported, no third injection, threshold revision or condition substitution; pulse witnesses supply exact initial values, thresholds and inputs.

correspondence.zh: 维持、取用与修复是同一展开中分化的作用。旧 Law.level 给出修复窗口起点；每步净增通过 repair_window_progress 接到原维持支持测试。仅第一次取用不同的两段历史改变实际修复支持，后续名义输入并不等于实际供给。没有真实系统的经验对应。
correspondence.en: Sustaining, drawing and repair differentiate roles within one unfolding. The inherited Law.level supplies the repair-window start; per-step progress through repair_window_progress feeds the original sustaining-support test. A first-draw difference changes actual repair support; later nominal inputs are not actual supply. No empirical correspondence to a real system is established.

detail.zh: 应用既有 Law 与展开定义，不把旧不可返回定理当作正面恢复结论的前提。源模块在本次闭包中重新实查。
detail.en: Applies the existing Law and unfolding definitions; the prior no-return theorem is not a premise of positive recovery. The source module is freshly checked in this closure.

output.zh: 给定输入历史产生的 level T、活动支持及门控递推。
output.en: The input history produces level T, activity support and the gated recurrence.

input.zh: 修复窗口起点的支持及其后有限正净贡献；或两项活动同时失去支持。
input.en: Support at the repair-window start and finite positive net contribution, or simultaneous loss of both supports.

conditions.zh: 同一规律、阈值和递推；无第三条供给。正面定理增加有限窗口前提。
conditions.en: Same law, thresholds and recurrence; no third supply. The positive theorem adds the finite-window premise.

detail.zh: 另一个已查磨损规律给出耗竭界；本次无导入或模型转换，不认领其原结果。
detail.en: A separately checked wear law supplies depletion bounds; no import or model adapter is claimed here.

detail.zh: 关系再形成与完整配置返回是不同目标，恢复不抹去中断历史；仅解释关联。
detail.en: Reformation and return to an entire configuration are different targets; recovery does not erase interruption. Interpretive relation only.

detail.zh: unsupported_pulse_never_recovers 反驳仅凭后续贡献表就保证恢复；recovered_history_neither_global_class 保留实际中断，不把全历史标签当作全部变化过程。
detail.en: unsupported_pulse_never_recovers refutes guaranteed recovery from a later contribution schedule alone; recovered_history_neither_global_class retains the interruption rather than replacing dynamics with a global label.

detail.zh: 旧材料修复、启动障碍及连续恢复域已有成果；新增量限于此既有门控规律中的有限窗口、吸收状态及实际历史比较。
detail.en: Earlier material repair, initiation obstructions and continuous recovery basins retain credit; the delta is the finite window, absorbing state and actual-history comparison in this inherited gated law.

limitations.zh: 未导出贡献来源、活动选择、物理规律、一般可恢复性、整个 Becoming 的关系构成或伦理必要性。有限恢复不保证窗口以后维持。G0/J/E 及强零实质公理目标保持明示。
limitations.en: Does not derive contribution sources, activity selection, physical laws, general recoverability, whole-Becoming relational constitution or ethical necessity. Finite recovery does not guarantee later maintenance. G0/J/E and the strong zero-substantive-axiom target remain explicit.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 实查9项新定理声明／10项新声明审计，4空、6仅标准依赖（propext、Quot.sound）。继承35项定理／60项空审计另列；共70项审计、64空。冻结成功回执绑定双模块源码、检查器、签名及日志。作者反审，无独立代理或经验验收。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 checks nine new theorem declarations / ten declaration audits: four empty, six using only standard dependencies (propext, Quot.sound). Separately credits 35 inherited theorems / 60 empty audits; total 70, 64 empty. A frozen successful receipt binds both module sources, checker, signatures and logs. Author counterreview; no independent-agent or empirical acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 有限修复接口已完成，接入关系怎样变化的共同构成论证；保留足够的既有规律解释作为竞争说明，不以另一局部例子替代完整目标。
next_delta.en: The finite repair interface is complete. Integrate it into the common constitutive account of relational change, retaining adequate law-based explanations as competitors rather than substituting another local example for the full target.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：在既有变化研究第13节应用新近关系更新规律，新增有限修复窗口及双失支持障碍。较早失败编译与最终成功快照均保留；修正共享章中不可返回所需的无正净修复前提，不改变旧证明。
history.en: 2026-10-09: §13 of the existing change study applies the recent relational renewal law to a finite repair window and a dual-support-loss obstruction. Earlier failed compilation and final successful snapshot are retained. Makes the no-positive-net-repair premise explicit in the shared chapter without changing the old proof.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：核读共享章中并行新增的 G0 对象修正及 C 条件比较，并核读其原指令及整合节。该比较属于另项研究，本记录的局部动力学、证明与范围不变；不将它计入本次数学验收。
history.en: 2026-10-09: Read concurrent clarification of G0’s object and the C-conditional comparison in the shared chapter, with its source instruction and integration section. That comparison belongs to another study; this record’s local dynamics, proof and scope remain unchanged and do not claim its mathematical acceptance.
